  MINUTES
  MONTEREY PARK CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL COMMUNITY MEETING
  JUNE 23, 2025

The City Council of the City of Monterey Park held a Special Community Meeting of the
Council at El Encanto located at 700 El Mercado Ave., Monterey Park 91754 on
Monday, June 23, 2025, at 5:00 p.m.

1.  Call to Order
  City Manager Alvarez called the meeting to order at 5:00 p.m.

2.  Roll Call

  City Manager Alvarez called the roll:

  Council Members Present: Elizabeth Yang,
  Council Members Absent: Jose Sanchez, Henry Lo, Vinh Ngo, Thomas Wong

  Also Present: Assistant City Manager Diana Garcia, Director of Public Works
  Shawn Igoe, Police Chief Scott Wiese, Director of Finance Martha Garcia, Fire
  Battalion Chief Robert DeRosa, Finance Manager Laura Borjon, Recreation and
  Community Services Manager Christina Alatorre, Library Manager Linda Vera,
  Public Works Manager Xochitl Tipan.

  Community Conversations

  I.  Welcome

  II.  Community members are invited for casual conversations and to learn
  more about City programs and services with Monterey Park Council
  Members and staff.

  III.  Adjournment

  Due to a lack of quorum, the meeting was adjourned at 5:15 p.m. by City
  Manager Alvarez.

_________________
Maychelle Yee
City Clerk

  MISSION STATEMENT
 The mission of the City of Monterey Park is to provide excellent service, foster growth and opportunity,
  and create a joyous and collaborative environment.
  .
